remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.text: The character disappears from your profile. Logs and loot stay untouched.

fold.orgaOnlySub: Other raiders do not see your wishes – nor whether someone added you.

days.timesKicker: From when · in quarter hours · empty = the whole evening
days.clearSub: Remove the time for {day} – then the whole evening counts.

prof.none: If you like – nothing is required.
prof.freeSub: Just info for the orga, e.g. for enchants or potions. Nothing is required.
prof.invite: If you like, add up to {max} main professions. Nothing is required.

wishItems.none: If you like – nothing is required.
wishItems.orgaOnlySub: Only you and the orga see your wish items – other raiders never do.
wishItems.invite: If you like, add up to {max} items you wish for. Nothing is required.
wishItems.readOnly: This character is in no loot council roster right now – your wish items stay visible, new ones can be added once it is in one again. Removing works any time.
wishItems.wowheadDown: Wowhead is not answering right now – the item was not saved. Please try again in a moment.
wishItems.full: {max} items entered – take one out to enter another.
wishItems.hint: A wish, not a promise – the orga sees it at the loot council.

first.title: No character yet
first.crumb: Choose how you want to start
first.logText: We may know you already – class and spec come from the log evaluations.
first.armoryText: Name and realm; class and level come from the armory.
first.manualText: Enter name, class and specs yourself.

char.orderSub: Your order per game version. The first character is suggested when you sign up — there is no "main".
char.claimedChip: Also added by: {names}. The orga sorts it out.
char.claimedCard: Also added by: {names}. The orga sees this in the roster and sorts it out.
char.unverifiedTip: No log, no loot and no armory answer knows this character – the guild bank cannot mail to it. Add it once more via “Armory” (the armory has to know it) or take the right one from the logs. Otherwise ask the orga to check it in game.
char.noSpec: No spec yet – add what you can play.
char.editSub: Change name, realm, class and specs – or pick the right character from the logs.

logs.seenTip: Confirmed with exactly this spec in the log evaluations.
logs.otherTip: The character shows up in the logs, but not with this spec. That is only a hint for the orga, not a block.

roles.suggested: Suggested from this character's specs: {answer}. You can change it any time.

impossible.canOfftank: The {cls} class has no tank spec – this cannot be switched on.
impossible.canHeal: The {cls} class has no healing spec – this cannot be switched on.

avoid.offText: Off. We raid as a community – everyone should get a chance. If it really does not work with someone, you can turn this on.
avoid.hint: The orga is asked when building a setup whether to take this into account – then you end up in different groups (different raids when raids run in parallel). It is not a guarantee.
avoid.orgaOnlySub: Only the orga sees this – and only in the setup, when it explicitly includes it. The people named never find out.
avoid.confirmText: In a community everyone should get a chance. Only turn this on if it really does not work with someone. Only the orga sees what you enter, and it decides for every setup whether to take it into account.

cal.revokeText: The link stops working at once. Calendars subscribed to it get no more raids.
cal.intro: One link with every raid you are signed up for — add it to your calendar once, every new raid shows up by itself.
cal.secretText: whoever has it sees your raids. Do not share it, do not post it.
cal.noBaseUrl: No public address is set (PUBLIC_BASE_URL) — without it no subscription link can be built.

wishes.hint: A wish, not a guarantee – the orga takes it into account for the setup.

note.placeholder: e.g. online only from 19:45 on Wednesdays.

add.title: Add character
add.name: Character name
add.nameHint: Letters only, at most 12 – in WoW Forever first and last name (12 each).
add.lastNameHint: In {version} characters carry a first and a last name – letters only, at most 12 each.
add.realmHint: Class, level and guild come from the armory when it answers – otherwise it stays a link.
add.fromRaidhelperSub: Class, specs and name come from your last Raid-Helper signups. If it does not fit, just change it.
add.noHit: No matching character in the logs. Try the armory or enter it by hand.
add.claimedSub: Added by: {names}. You can take it anyway – the orga sorts it out.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.logHint: Pick the character as it is named in the logs – similarly spelled names come first. Name and class are then taken from the log.
edit.nameHint: As the character is named in game.
edit.classHint: Another class starts with new specs.
edit.renameHint: A new name also replaces "{from}" in rosters, signups, guild bank requests and attendance entries.
edit.noHit: No matching character in the logs – change the name by hand.

tabs.infoTip: What belongs to you, not to a character: attendance, weekdays, wishes, note, calendar
tabs.allTip: Every character of every raider – for the orga only.
tabs.addTip: Add another character of this game version – from the logs, via the armory or by hand.

info.groupRaiding: Raiding · for every character of the version

roster.sumOther: in the roster with another character
roster.none: With this character you are in no roster of this version.
roster.readOnly: The orga sets the status – shown here for reference.

loot.none: No loot for this character yet.

dungeons.badgeSub: The sync tool uploads runs and achievement points. Matched by name and realm.

all.loadError: The characters could not be loaded: {message}

wishTip.one: {count} wish item – only the orga sees it
wishTip.other: {count} wish items – only the orga sees them

all.editSub: Rename {name} or link it to a character from the logs.
all.removeText: The character leaves the profile. Logs, loot and past signups stay.
all.none: No raider has a character in their profile yet.
